description: This header defines an API for extending PyTorch's core operator library with user-defined operators and data types, including macros and classes for registration, schema definition, and dispatch handling.

classes.name: CppFunction
classes.description: Represents a C++ function implementing an operator, capable of handling various registration scenarios including lambdas, function pointers, and boxed kernels.

classes.name: Library
classes.description: Provides an API for defining and registering operators, schemas, and implementations within a namespace, supporting macros for static initialization and dispatch key specialization.

classes.name: detail::TorchLibraryInit
classes.description: Handles deferred initialization of Torch libraries, especially in mobile or lazy-loading contexts.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Creates a CppFunction associated with a specific dispatch key or device type, used for operator registration.

methods.name: schema
methods.description: Constructs a FunctionSchema from a string with optional alias analysis kind.

methods.name: def
methods.description: Defines an operator schema within a library, optionally with tags and verification.

methods.name: impl
methods.description: Registers an implementation for an operator, possibly for a specific dispatch key.

methods.name: fallback
methods.description: Registers a fallback implementation for operators without specific implementations.

methods.name: class_
methods.description: Registers a class type within a library for exposing C++ classes to Torch.
